full_page.content:
c. 1940
The following is a faithful transcription of handwritten notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
If there is a blessing of any kind to come from atheism - in itself the Climax of insanity - it will be this Unity among those professing to believe in God.
After all, if Religion can be defined as: "The science of relationship between God and the rational creature, and dependence of the latter on his Creator - and his neighbor - then religion must be one, and whatever is contrary to that unity is opposed to that peace between men themselves and God their Creator that ought to permiate human society - the peace of which the Good God Himself, through the Apostle assures us "surpasseth all understanding" - the peace that the Divine Ruler of the universe will no doubt establish between men and nations even at the cost of hells on earth before that peace be perfected.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
May 7, 1940
To Rabbi Rosenwasser.
Why athesiam the climax of insanity ... ?
. I claim that gratitude is one of the very first and surest in- . dication of intelligence and athesiam is the blackest ingratitude possible.
Fr. S. - ut supra
" ... religion the science of our relationship with God and our neighbor and our dependence on both." Futhermore athesiam robs man of supernatural hope the very soul of human happiness.
